purpose: Assess the missing top-down source phrase/typed-slot/morphology mechanism distinctly from the source-word research. Matched context and flipped lexical output are separate. No framework adoption or default runtime data activation.
additional_morphology_direction: sw-en only if a retained source morphology toolchain is actually qualified; absent capability is recorded, never replaced by invented output.

arms.meaning: Current native catalog whole/sentence reference and current source-partial route; retain explicit-source and automatic-language outcomes separately. Provider-backed path only in separately bounded native spot checks, never fabricated full reference.
Existing bounded native phrase windows, descending complete context length, exact reviewed phrase contexts. Report matches and lexical output separately.
Existing ContextMappingMatcher with explicit finite literal/slot/focus alternatives and same bounds. No named arbitrary capture or unseen morphology permission.

Bounded source-only typed capture of possessor/name, numeric or protected identifier slots, plus full attested source morphological forms. Captured text remains original outside output focus; no target-string interpolation or automatic grammar transfer.

Compare actual retained HFST/Apertium or equivalent finite-state source morphology only where tool/data are qualified. Keep analysis/generation provenance and ambiguity. Analyzer tags do not alone authorize target meaning.

typed_slot_contract.possessive_pronoun: Finite explicit English possessive determiners; exact captured bytes retained.
typed_slot_contract.possessive_np: Bounded1–3name-shaped tokens followed by apostrophe-s or plural possessive apostrophe. Shape proves grammatical possessor only, not named-entity identity. Nested/ambiguous parses retained as abstentions.
typed_slot_contract.number: Existing native protected-number boundaries, no normalization or value change; agreement may only use explicit attested features.
typed_slot_contract.identifier: Exact original URL/handle/code/name range stays outside flipped focus. A protected span may lie in matched context but may never overlap replaced output.
typed_slot_contract.binding_output: Every slot reports exact source UTF16 range and original value; no slot text generated by the matcher.

precedence.context_vs_output: Context range may be much longer than emitted noun/phrase focus. Density cost counts only complete native tokens in the output focus.
precedence.longest_first: Build windows once, index candidates, match longer more-specific contexts first. An ambiguous longer atomic construction blocks unsafe nested generic fallback before known/budget filtering.
precedence.backoff: Unmatched larger windows may try smaller complete windows. Recognized compound may permit only explicitly reviewed inner head units; no global ban on valid school/music/window components.
precedence.ambiguity: Multiple analyses assigning conflicting meaning/atomicity/output geometry withhold the affected scope. Lexical identity/POS alone does not settle sense.
precedence.budgets: Identical10/25/50percent native whole-message budgets across arms; max1 floor, disjoint outputs, one concept occurrence/message,128units, no budget override.
precedence.known: none,all_function,all_function_plus50/100/300frozenconcepts, plus an atomic-known contrast. Known larger units cannot expose unsafe nested words.

bounds.extended_window_policy: Longer-than8word family contexts recorded as capability gaps; no hidden cap enlargement.

evaluation.authored_cases: At most160 frozen positive/negative/metamorphic cases, clearly authored diagnostics; targets/patterns/expected scope categories fixed before matching output.
evaluation.TRAIN: All9535 existing eligible BST TRAIN role-play turns. Report family/context reach, actual output availability, content depth, distinct concepts, known-word exhaustion and per-length bins; not population acceptance.
negative_strata: possessor vs proposition and nested names
overbudget/known atomic unit and unsafe inner fallback
evaluation.semantic_review: Fixed deterministic packet of actual outputs and abstentions; meaning/form/reading separate, author and root labels frozen independently. Authored expectations are not independent quality evidence.

resource_limits.native_provider: No new models; reuse installed models only in explicitly bounded spotcheck, at most12sourcecases per available direction. Apple unavailable provider remains explicit.
resource_limits.toolchain: Inspect existing retained source and package feasibility first; no system install/service/VM change. Optional isolated tool qualification must have exact versions/licenses and explicit bounded disk/CPU/RSS/time.
resource_limits.runtime: No network inference, no provider/model calls in source-only matching arms.

not_claimed: General target grammar generation or arbitrary named-slot target inflection
HFST/Apertium deployment merely because a family has finite states
All110directions or automatic language identification from a word hit
